rundown: Thiago Agustin Tirante beat Alejandro Tabilo in sets: 7-5, 7-6.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 13, 8:02 AM ET. It had Alejandro Tabilo 52% and Thiago Agustin Tirante 48%.

Final: Alejandro Tabilo 0 – Thiago Agustin Tirante 2. Wrong winner: it had Alejandro Tabilo at 52%, and Thiago Agustin Tirante (48%) won.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: Alejandro Tabilo to win: the algo gave it 52%, THE PICK — lost.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body: Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
